name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
license: Kimi K3.1 Pro License (modified MIT; Model-as-a-Service operators with over $20M in trailing 12-month revenue need a separate agreement, and products over 100M MAU or $20M monthly revenue must display "Kimi K3.1-Pro")
archDisplay: Post-trained version of Kimi K3 (same 2.8T-parameter MoE base) with substantially larger multi-domain joint RL; 1M-token context; always-on thinking with reasoning_effort low, high or max (default max); text, image and video input
note: First model of Moonshot's K3.1 series, launched Oct 23, 2026 on Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code and the Kimi API, alongside a 2-3x faster Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed. Moonshot calls it a post-trained Kimi K3 with much more RL compute. Weights were published on Hugging Face (moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro) on Nov 4, 2026 under the Kimi K3.1 Pro License: 2.8T total / 104B activated MoE (896 experts, 16 per token, 2 shared), 93 layers mixing 69 KDA and 24 Gated DSA attention layers, MXFP4 weights with MXFP8 activations, text and image input. Moonshot also says it removed cyber-related data from mid-training and RL for the open-weight release. API price $2/$10 per Mtok (Artificial Analysis, from Kimi's API; Kimi's own pricing table renders client-side and could not be read). Scores are Moonshot's at max effort. NOT FILED: OfficeQA Pro v2 (64.4; the corpus officeqa-pro column holds v1 figures, e.g. Opus 5.5 67.7 vs 62.2 on v2), Frontier Finance (58.6), ProgramBench (binary-score variant), GDPval-AA v2.1 (AA re-based scale), Agents' Last Exam, GDP.pdf, ChartoGraphy, ZeroBench, HLE without tools, and Kimi's internal suites (Kimi Code Bench, Hallu Bench, xdev-bench-hard); DeepSWE v1.1 (75.5) and MMMU-Pro (84.1) were held at launch because they appeared in only one transcription of the image grid; both are filed from the Nov 4 Hugging Face card, which states them in text. Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed is not filed separately: no benchmark table and no first-party price could be read.
